title: Basket Share on Late-Delivery Fee Refunds - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For a late-delivery fee refund on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, a basket share is added to the refund share. It depends on the basket value of the order, which is measured on the order's line charges, from the amount billed on them.

| Basket value | Basket share added |
|---|---|
| $100.00 or more | 10% |
| $70.00 or more, but below $100.00 | 4% |
| Below $70.00 | Nothing |

### Boundary cases

| Basket value | Basket share |
|---|---|
| $69.99 | Nothing |
| $70.00 | 4% |
| $99.99 | 4% |
| $100.00 | 10% |

Fees on the order are not part of the basket value.

**Example (hypothetical).** A Same-Day Delivery order with line charges billed at $82.45 has a basket share of 4%.
